correctness.rationale: On a tree each seed-to-sentinel infection time is the sum of one independent unit exponential per unique path edge (zero at the seed). Uniform averaging gives total distance divided by n for the mean, and the miss tail e^(-t)/n times the polynomial with coefficients c_j(v)=#{u:d(u,v)>j} in the t^j/j! basis. One can check the small-order proof structurally: moving across an edge from w to m with component sizes a on w's side and b on m's side changes the total distance by a-b. A nonmedian has a neighbor on a side b>n/2; otherwise every path from it has nondecreasing total distance because forward components are nested. If n<=6 and b>a then a<=2. The difference c_j(w)-c_j(m) is the number at distance j from m on m's side minus the number at distance j from w on w's side. The side of size at most two has shell counts (1) or (1,1); the larger connected side has at least as many vertices in each such shell, with a strict inequality somewhere since b>a. Thus a nonmedian can strictly improve at every t>0. The separate finite replay also confirms median dominance for all 6212 nonmedians on 1442 labeled trees, Cayley counts (1,1,3,16,125,1296). On the given broom the distance sums are (12,11,12,15,20,17,17). Site 1 dominates each site 2–6 in every coefficient and strictly in at least one. For 0 minus 1, the replay and direct distance counts give -t+t^2/2+t^3/6, negative before its only positive root (sqrt(33)-3)/2 and positive after. Exactly 0 and 1 tie there, and their mean times are 12/7 and 11/7. The result neither covers t=0 nor asserts that this broom is the only seven-site witness.

evidence: Leskovec et al. frame general sensor placement and detection-delay objectives. Holme treats SIR mean discovery time, ending at sentinel infection or outbreak extinction. The closely matching catalogue record uses two sentinels on a five-site path.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A general objective framework does not itself fix the sharp cutoff; the inspected exact tables and the two-sentinel theorem do not imply the one-sentinel theorem by specialization.

evidence: Distance median status follows from the homogeneous tree first-passage representation, but the small-order comparison uses the coefficientwise order of shell counts. The broom phase change additionally uses the sign of a quantitative polynomial difference.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Neither mean optimality, a static centrality discrepancy nor a mean-versus-deadline counterexample with two sites establishes the one-site lower cutoff or exact switching time.

evidence: On these trees mean infection time equals a static distance sum, but the deadline objective depends on all ball volumes around the site, or equivalently on finite mixtures of Erlang tails. The first-passage and static-center passages do not identify those exact all-deadline comparisons.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Even known separations between degree and closeness do not decide whether, when, or uniquely which site minimizes the deadline tail; switching to multiple sentinels also changes the time to a minimum over sites.
searches: Resultary d8c51a90962c, mean versus deadline sentinel disagreement

evidence: Holme's small graphs include the comparable graph-order range 3–7, but the measured variable is SIR mean discovery-to-extinction, not positive-time exceedance in homogeneous SI. The checked catalogue examples use two sentinels or eventual reachability.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Shared graph orders or overlap in topologies do not make the listed values or optima counts for the same invariant. No separate exact single-sentinel SI table covering the frozen comparison was established.

originality.rationale: The closest same-model indexed record changes the number of sentinels from one to two, and a nearby single-sentinel record changes the random process and score. Inspected literature gives the general outbreak detection problem, known first-passage ingredients, different SIR exact tables, and static centrality separations, not the sharp all-positive-deadline theorem and phase comparison stated here. The decision credits familiar ingredients and is bounded to the inspected corpus.
residual_risks: A bounded unproductive outbound lookup is not evidence of absence. Unindexed equivalent statements using Erlang mixtures, distance distributions or stochastic centers could change the priority assessment; distinct same-day catalogue dates do not establish order.

value.rationale: For defensive monitoring, minimizing the expected wait and minimizing the probability of missing a fixed deadline are different natural choices. The result identifies exactly when the two can first diverge in a transparent tree model and exhibits an exact crossover with unique optima on both sides. The finite cutoff is therefore meaningful independently of the census and without asserting empirical application to a particular outbreak.
